About Me

I am a Software Engineer and Technical Lead focused on optimizing complex industrial processes through modern software and IoT solutions.

Currently, I am working at ÖZKA İNŞAAT, where I play a dual role as a Technical Lead and Developer. My work focuses on digitalizing and optimizing construction workflows to increase efficiency and safety on large-scale project sites.

What I Do at ÖZKA İNŞAAT

I lead the development of specialized applications that solve real-world logistical and safety challenges in the construction industry:

  • Truck Movement Tracking: Optimizing logistics and material transport through real-time monitoring.
  • Tunnel Personnel Tracking: Ensuring the safety of workers in high-risk environments using IoT solutions.
  • Site Equipment Tracking: Managing and monitoring heavy machinery and equipment across expansive construction sites.

Technical Expertise

My experience bridges the gap between high-level software architecture and low-level hardware integration:

  • Backend Development: Expertise in .NET ecosystem (ASP.NET Core, Web API, .NET 9).
  • IoT & Embedded Systems: Working with ESP32, SIM800, and various tracking sensors to collect real-world data.
  • Architecture & Design: Implementing clean code, Repository Pattern, and scalable database designs.
  • Optimization: Using data-driven insights to improve industrial operational efficiency.

The Blog

This blog is my personal space to document the technical challenges I face and the solutions I build. From deep dives into .NET to practical IoT implementations, I share my journey as a builder and a problem solver.
